data.name: FastFlags_AddTip
data.value: Add this FastFlag to the list.

data.name: FastFlags_RawTip
data.value: Edit all the FastFlags at once as raw JSON.

data.name: FastFlags_RemoveTip
data.value: Remove this FastFlag from the list.

data.name: Main_LaunchTip
data.value: Start Roblox, or use the arrow to choose the version source.

data.name: Main_OpenProfileTip
data.value: Open the Sirstrap profile on Codeberg.

data.name: Main_OpenRepositoryTip
data.value: Open the Sirstrap repository on Codeberg.

data.name: Settings_CleanerCleanOnExitTip
data.value: Run SirHurt Cleaner right after Roblox closes.

data.name: Settings_CleanerCleanOnLaunchTip
data.value: Run SirHurt Cleaner right before Roblox starts.

data.name: Settings_CleanerCleanProtectedFilesTip
data.value: Also delete the files that hold your logins and settings, such as Sirstrap.ini.

data.name: Settings_CleanerCleanTempFoldersTip
data.value: Also empty the temporary folders of Windows and of every user.

data.name: Settings_CleanerEnabledTip
data.value: Allow SirHurt Cleaner to wipe the Roblox and Sirstrap data from this computer.

data.name: Settings_CleanerOptionsTip
data.value: Choose when SirHurt Cleaner runs and what it removes.

data.name: Settings_OpenSettingsFileTip
data.value: Open Sirstrap.ini to edit the settings as plain text.

data.name: Settings_RobloxCdnUriOverrideTip
data.value: Download Roblox from this server instead of the fastest one found by Sirstrap, for example https://setup.rbxcdn.com. Leave empty to choose it automatically.

data.name: Settings_RobloxFastFlagsEnabledTip
data.value: Apply the FastFlags listed in the FastFlags tab every time Roblox starts.

data.name: Settings_RobloxIncognitoTip
data.value: Move your Roblox data aside while you play, so the session leaves no trace. Requires multi-instance.

data.name: Settings_RobloxInstallationPathTip
data.value: Choose the folder where Sirstrap installs and keeps the Roblox versions.

data.name: Settings_RobloxMultiInstanceTip
data.value: Allow more than one Roblox window to be open at the same time.

data.name: Settings_RobloxVersionOverrideTip
data.value: Always install this exact version, for example version-0123456789abcdef, instead of the one from the version source. Leave empty to follow the version source.

data.name: Settings_RobloxVersionSourceTip
data.value: Choose where Sirstrap looks up which Roblox version to install.

data.name: Settings_RunCleanerNowTip
data.value: Close Roblox and SirHurt and delete their data right away. This cannot be undone.

data.name: Settings_SaveTip
data.value: Save the settings and close this window.

data.name: Settings_SirHurtPathTip
data.value: The folder where SirHurt is installed. Sirstrap finds it automatically.

data.name: Settings_SirstrapAccentColorTip
data.value: Choose the color used to highlight the interface.

data.name: Settings_SirstrapAutoUpdateTip
data.value: Download and install new Sirstrap releases automatically at startup.

data.name: Settings_SirstrapChannelTip
data.value: Choose the release channel to update from, for example -beta to receive pre-releases.

data.name: Settings_SirstrapFontFamilyTip
data.value: Choose the font used across the whole interface.

data.name: Settings_SirstrapLanguageTip
data.value: Choose the language of the interface. System follows the language of Windows.

data.name: Settings_SirstrapTelemetryTip
data.value: Send anonymous crash reports and usage metrics to help fix bugs.

data.name: Settings_SirstrapTrayModeTip
data.value: Choose when Sirstrap hides in the system tray instead of staying on screen.

data.name: Settings_UninstallTip
data.value: Remove Sirstrap and its data from this computer, and stop it from opening Roblox links.
